title: Endogenous Calmodulin Co-Purified with VPS13s Detected by Western Blotting
author: Dazhi Li
materials: Buffer B (200 mM NaCl, 50 mM HEPES, pH 7.2, 6% glycerol)

steps.title: Express and purify tagged VPS13
steps.instruction: Express C‑terminally tagged VPS13C or N‑terminally tagged Ct VPS13 in Expi293F cells and purify them following the protocol at doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rm7vz92d4gx1/v1.

steps.title: Purify proteins in Buffer B
steps.instruction: Purify the proteins in Buffer B containing 200 mM NaCl, 50 mM HEPES (pH 7.2), 6 % glycerol, 1 mM TCEP, and supplement with either Ca²⁺ or EGTA as required.

steps.title: Run SDS‑PAGE gels
steps.instruction: Separate the eluted proteins by electrophoresis on appropriate precast gels for visualization.

substeps.instruction: Load samples onto a 4–20 % Tris‑glycine gel to visualize calmodulin.
Load samples onto a 3–8 % Tris‑acetate gel to visualize VPS13 proteins.

steps.title: Transfer proteins to PVDF membrane
steps.instruction: Transfer the resolved proteins onto a PVDF membrane at 90 V for 1 h 30 min at 4 °C using transfer buffer composed of 25 mM Tris, 192 mM glycine, and 20 % methanol.

steps.title: Block membrane with BSA
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane in 3 % BSA in TBST for 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Incubate with primary anti‑calmodulin antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate the blocked membrane overnight at 4 °C with anti‑calmodulin primary antibody (MedChemExpress Catalog #HY‑P82082) diluted 1:1000 in 3 % BSA/TBST.

steps.title: Wash membrane after primary antibody
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane three times with TBST, each wash lasting 15 minutes.

steps.title: Incubate with HRP‑conjugated secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane for 1 h at room temperature with goat anti‑rabbit HRP‑conjugated secondary antibody (MilliporeSigma Catalog #AP307P) diluted 1:1000 in TBST.

steps.title: Wash membrane after secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane three times with TBST, each wash lasting 15 minutes.

steps.title: Develop and image blot
steps.instruction: Develop the membrane using an ECL substrate and capture the chemiluminescent signal with an ImageQuant LAS 4000 imaging system.
